primary_manual_review: All failed G episodes at predeclared seed42; no cherry picking
automatic_review: All declared episodes across seeds42/43/44; indicators are observations, not causal labels
category_rule: Record one primary observed failure and optional secondary mechanisms; evaluator outcome alone does not establish cause. Preserve ambiguous cases as unresolved. Review original query, public trace and evaluator evidence offline; never supply evaluation goals/reasons to an actor.
data_audit: Check exact provenance and training isolation; count targets after public errors, explicit discovery and finish contexts. No new samples or labels for training.

n28_admission.required: Same actionable mechanism in manually reviewed G failures; intervention must use public observations only, and materially differ from previously rejected global discovery gate, verification or ID prompting
n28_admission.otherwise: Finish N27 and stop online experiments; keep original9B+G. Do not repair SFT solely to justify another training run.

exclusions: No normal failures excluded; successful episodes retained as context for automatic indicators. Any missing/changed receipt aborts analysis rather than silently skipping.
resources: CPU only; no actor/judge inference, training or simulator reruns. GPUs remain available; A800 permanent judge untouched.
limitations: Historically exposed development tasks; overlapping N25/N26 tasks must not be pooled as independent cases; attribution is evidence-based diagnosis, not causal treatment effect.
